title: 补充：工具函数库（statcomp_exam_toolkit.R）
knowledge: 断网开卷考试时，把 statcomp_exam_toolkit.R 放到本地，通过 source("路径/statcomp_exam_toolkit.R") 加载
所有函数提供统一接口：MC 类返回 c(est, se, var_est)；Bootstrap 类返回 c(theta_hat, se, bias) 或矩阵；MCMC 类返回 list(chain, reject_rate)，接受率 = 1 - reject_rate
每个函数都支持 seed 参数，便于复现
使用顶部搜索框输入函数名（如 mh_random_walk、accept_reject）即可定位
完整 .R 源文件附在仓库根目录：statcomp_exam_toolkit.R

sections.html: 快速计算 MC 标准误、方差缩减率 VRP、样本汇总。

sections.code:
# Monte Carlo 标准误：sd(x) / sqrt(n)
mc_se <- function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))

# 方差缩减率：(var_simple - var_new) / var_simple，越接近 1 越好
vrp <- function(var_simple, var_new) (var_simple - var_new) / var_simple

# 一键输出 mean / var / sd / se
summ <- function(x) c(mean = mean(x), var = var(x), sd = sd(x), se = mc_se(x))

print_result <- function(name, value) {
  cat("\n---", name, "---\n"); print(value)
}

problems.title: 1. 随机变量生成：inv_sample / discrete_inv_sample / accept_reject / rmvnorm_chol / rnorm_mixture

sections.html: 1.1 逆变换法 inv_sample(n, qfun, seed)：给定反函数 $F^{-1}(u)$，生成样本。
1.2 离散逆变换 discrete_inv_sample(n, values, probs, seed)
1.3 接受拒绝法 accept_reject(n, rproposal, dtarget_over_cproposal, seed, max_iter)，返回 list(sample, accept_rate, iter)。
1.4 多元正态 rmvnorm_chol(n, mu, Sigma, seed)
1.5 两正态混合 rnorm_mixture(n, p, mu1, sd1, mu2, sd2, seed)

problems.title: 2. MC 积分与方差缩减：mc_integrate_unit / mc_integrate_ab / mc_antithetic_unit / mc_control_variate / mc_importance / mc_stratified_unit

sections.html: 2.4 控制变量法 control variate：$\hat\theta = \overline{g(X) + c^\star(h(X) - E[h])}$，其中 $c^\star = -\mathrm{Cov}(g,h)/\mathrm{Var}(h)$。
综合调用示例：估计 $\int_0^1 e^{-x}/(1+x^2)\,dx$，依次跑 unit / antithetic / control_variate / importance / stratified，对比 var_est 即可看到方差缩减效果。

problems.title: 3. MC 统计推断（I 类错误与功效）：simulate_rejection_rate / normal_mean_reject_z / normal_mean_reject_t / power_curve_normal_mean
4. Bootstrap & Jackknife：bootstrap_reps / bootstrap_se_bias / bootstrap_ci_manual / bootstrap_t_ci / jackknife_se_bias

sections.code:
bootstrap_ci_manual <- function(x, stat, B = 2000, conf = 0.95, seed = NULL) {
  theta0 <- stat(as.matrix(x))
  reps   <- bootstrap_reps(x, stat, B, seed)
  alpha  <- 1 - conf; z <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2); se <- sd(reps)
  q <- as.numeric(quantile(reps, c(alpha / 2, 1 - alpha / 2), type = 1))
  rbind(
    normal     = c(lower = theta0 - z * se,   upper = theta0 + z * se),
    basic      = c(lower = 2 * theta0 - q[2], upper = 2 * theta0 - q[1]),
    percentile = c(lower = q[1],              upper = q[2])
  )
}

jackknife_se_bias <- function(x, stat) {
  x <- as.matrix(x); n <- nrow(x); theta0 <- stat(x)
  theta_j <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 1:n) theta_j[i] <- stat(x[-i, , drop = FALSE])
  theta_bar <- mean(theta_j)
  bias <- (n - 1) * (theta_bar - theta0)
  se   <- sqrt((n - 1) * mean((theta_j - theta_bar)^2))
  c(theta_hat = theta0, se = se, bias = bias)
}

sections.html: 独立建议分布 MH：接受率 $\alpha = \min\!\left\{1,\,\dfrac{\pi(y)\,q(x_{\text{old}})}{\pi(x_{\text{old}})\,q(y)}\right\}$。返回 reject_rate，对应接受率 = 1 - reject_rate。
随机游走 MH（对称提议，$q$ 自抵消）。返回 reject_rate；判断混合质量时可参考接受率 $= 1 -$ reject_rate，经验上随机游走链以 20%–50% 为佳。

chain_check <- function(chain, burn = floor(length(chain) / 2),
                        probs = c(.1, .25, .5, .75, .9)) {
  y <- chain[(burn + 1):length(chain)]
  list(mean = mean(y), sd = sd(y), quantile = quantile(y, probs))
}

sections.html:
用途：给一堆数据，假设来自 $p\,N(\mu_1,\sigma_1^2)+(1-p)\,N(\mu_2,\sigma_2^2)$，估计 5 个参数。

E 步：$w_i = \dfrac{p\,\varphi(x_i;\mu_1,\sigma_1)}{p\,\varphi(x_i;\mu_1,\sigma_1) + (1-p)\,\varphi(x_i;\mu_2,\sigma_2)}$

M 步：$p \leftarrow \bar w,\; \mu_1 \leftarrow \dfrac{\sum w_i x_i}{\sum w_i},\; \sigma_1^2 \leftarrow \dfrac{\sum w_i (x_i-\mu_1)^2}{\sum w_i}$（$\mu_2,\sigma_2$ 对称用 $1-w_i$）

sections.code:
em_norm2 <- function(x, p = 0.5, mu1 = quantile(x, .25), mu2 = quantile(x, .75),
                     sd1 = sd(x), sd2 = sd(x), tol = 1e-8, max_iter = 1000) {
  loglik_old <- -Inf
  for (it in 1:max_iter) {
    # E 步
    dens1 <- p * dnorm(x, mu1, sd1)
    dens2 <- (1 - p) * dnorm(x, mu2, sd2)
    w <- dens1 / (dens1 + dens2)
    # M 步
    p   <- mean(w)
    mu1 <- sum(w * x) / sum(w)
    mu2 <- sum((1 - w) * x) / sum(1 - w)
    sd1 <- sqrt(sum(w * (x - mu1)^2) / sum(w))
    sd2 <- sqrt(sum((1 - w) * (x - mu2)^2) / sum(1 - w))
    loglik <- sum(log(p * dnorm(x, mu1, sd1) + (1 - p) * dnorm(x, mu2, sd2)))
    if (abs(loglik - loglik_old) < tol) break
    loglik_old <- loglik
  }
  list(p = p, mu1 = mu1, mu2 = mu2, sd1 = sd1, sd2 = sd2,
       loglik = loglik, iter = it)
}

sections.html: 初值默认取 25% / 75% 分位数；若数据强双峰可手工指定 mu1, mu2 让收敛更快。
